```{=html}
<style>
.w044 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w044 .w044-cap {
  text-align: center; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 8px; margin: 0 auto 6px;
  max-width: 460px; border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w044 .w044-arrow { text-align: center; color: #d81e2e; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w044 .w044-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin: 0 auto 0.75rem; max-width: 460px; }
.w044 .w044-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; cursor: grab;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); user-select: none;
}
.w044 .w044-item.w044-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w044 .w044-item.w044-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w044 .w044-label { flex: 1 1 auto; font-weight: 600; }
.w044 .w044-mini {
  flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w044 .w044-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w044 button.w044-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w044 .w044-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w044 .w044-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w044 .w044-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w044 .w044-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w044 .w044-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w044 iw" id="w044">
  <div class="w044-cap">Capital One, 2019 — the chain of the breach</div>
  <div class="w044-arrow">▼</div>
  <div class="w044-list" aria-label="steps to order"></div>
  <div class="w044-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w044-btn w044-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w044-btn w044-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w044-btn w044-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w044-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w044-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w044-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    The chain began with a misconfigured WAF on a cloud instance whose attached identity held far more permission than it needed; a server-side request forgery flaw made the WAF query the platform’s internal metadata service, which returned the identity’s temporary credentials, and those credentials could list and copy the contents of more than 700 storage buckets — a security control itself became the attack vector. See <a href="#sec-04-firewall-types-ngfw-waf">the section on firewall types, NGFW and WAF</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w044');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w044-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w044-msg');
  // start order deliberately scrambled; data-order gives the correct position
  const START = [
    ['the metadata service returns the identity’s temporary credentials', 2],
    ['a misconfigured WAF runs on a cloud instance whose identity holds far more permission than it needs', 0],
    ['the credentials list and copy the contents of more than 700 storage buckets', 3],
    ['a server-side request forgery flaw makes the WAF query the platform’s internal metadata service', 1]
  ];
  let dragged = null;

  function clearMarks() {
    [...list.children].forEach(it => it.classList.remove('w044-right', 'w044-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w044-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeItem(label, order) {
    const it = document.createElement('div');
    it.className = 'w044-item';
    it.dataset.order = order;
    it.draggable = true;
    const lab = document.createElement('span');
    lab.className = 'w044-label';
    lab.textContent = label;
    const up = document.createElement('button');
    up.type = 'button'; up.className = 'w044-mini'; up.textContent = '▲';
    up.setAttribute('aria-label', 'move up');
    const down = document.createElement('button');
    down.type = 'button'; down.className = 'w044-mini'; down.textContent = '▼';
    down.setAttribute('aria-label', 'move down');
    up.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (it.previousElementSibling) { list.insertBefore(it, it.previousElementSibling); clearMarks(); }
    });
    down.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (it.nextElementSibling) { list.insertBefore(it.nextElementSibling, it); clearMarks(); }
    });
    it.addEventListener('dragstart', () => { dragged = it; });
    it.addEventListener('dragend', () => { dragged = null; });
    it.addEventListener('dragover', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (!dragged || dragged === it) return;
      const r = it.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (e.clientY < r.top + r.height / 2) list.insertBefore(dragged, it);
      else list.insertBefore(dragged, it.nextElementSibling);
      clearMarks();
    });
    it.addEventListener('drop', e => e.preventDefault());
    it.appendChild(lab); it.appendChild(up); it.appendChild(down);
    return it;
  }
  list.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  list.addEventListener('drop', e => e.preventDefault());
  root.querySelector('.w044-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0;
    [...list.children].forEach((it, i) => {
      it.classList.remove('w044-right', 'w044-wrong');
      if (Number(it.dataset.order) === i) { it.classList.add('w044-right'); right++; }
      else it.classList.add('w044-wrong');
    });
    if (right === START.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ Correct — a security control itself became the attack vector.'; msg.className = 'w044-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + START.length + ' steps are in the right position (green).'; msg.className = 'w044-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  function build() {
    list.textContent = '';
    START.forEach(t => list.appendChild(makeItem(t[0], t[1])));
  }
  root.querySelector('.w044-reset').addEventListener('click', () => { build(); clearMarks(); root.querySelector('.w044-expl').hidden = true; });
  root.querySelector('.w044-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    [...list.children]
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.order) - Number(b.dataset.order))
      .forEach(it => { list.appendChild(it); it.classList.add('w044-right'); });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w044-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w044-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  build();
})();
</script>
```
